name: enterLoanInformation
intent: Record the supplied loan application information as the current new request.
pre: No loan request with the supplied requestid exists.
post: Set the new request's request identifier to requestid.
Set the new request's name to name.
Set the new request's requested loan amount to loanamount.
Set the new request's loan purpose to loanpurpose.
Set the new request's income to income.
Set the new request's phone number to phonenumber.
Set the new request's postal address to postaladdress.
Set the new request's zip code to zipcode.
Set the new request's email to email.
Set the new request's work references to workreferences.
Set the new request's credit references to creditreferences.
Set the new request's checking-account number to checkingaccountnumber.
Set the new request's security number to securitynumber.
Store the new request among the system's loan requests.
Make the new request the current loan request.
difficulty_basis: Many explicit scalar initializations but no branching, association effects or pre-state arithmetic.
scenarios: All thirteen supplied fields, stored request, current binding and true result checked.
effects_audit: No initial status or score, credit/account-history creation, income/amount validation or submission side effect inferred. Associated histories required by calculateScore are not created here.

name: calculateScore
intent: Assign the benchmark credit score to the current request and submit it.
pre: A current loan request is present.
The current request has checking-account history.
The current request has credit history.
post: Set the current request's credit score to 100.
Set the current request's status to SUBMITTED.
difficulty_basis: Constant score assignment and status transition under history-presence guards.
scenarios: Score/result 100 and SUBMITTED checked with both histories present.
effects_audit: Score is the literal benchmark constant 100, not a formula based on credit history. No actual risk scoring, history fetching or workflow guard invented.
